task: Implement parse_config for the server without importing CLI config parsing behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Server parse_config reads TOML from the config directory and applies environment variable overrides.
Server config is read once at startup; hot-reload requires an explicit SIGHUP or API trigger.
Server config parsing must validate all required keys before the service accepts connections.
When parse_config spans CLI and server contexts, confirm the reload and validation semantics first.
CLI: parse_config reads flags and env vars at each invocation; no config file is ever written.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: CLI flag-based config model is incompatible with the file-based server config

candidate_memories.content: Old tooling note says config parsing should be unified so CLI and server share the same logic.
